pipeline.name: weekly-content-review
pipeline.description: Weekly content performance review — SEO audit, growth analysis, and editorial action plan

parent.title: [{{date}}] Weekly content review
description: Coordinate the weekly content performance review. You are the orchestrator.
1. When SEO Expert finishes the performance audit: review findings, then unblock the Growth Analyst task (set it to `todo`)
2. When Growth Analyst finishes the opportunity analysis: unblock your own action plan task
3. Create follow-up tasks based on the combined findings (content refreshes, new articles, technical fixes)

tasks.title: [{{date}}] SEO performance audit — last 7 days
description: Audit blog SEO performance for the past 7 days.
- `node scripts/tools/gsc.mjs stats --json` — Google total clicks, impressions, CTR, avg position
- `node scripts/tools/gsc.mjs queries --limit 20 --json` — Google top queries by clicks
- `node scripts/tools/gsc.mjs pages --limit 20 --json` — Google top pages by clicks
- `node scripts/tools/gsc.mjs opportunities --json` — quick wins: high impressions, low CTR
- `node scripts/tools/bing-webmaster.mjs stats --json` — Bing search performance (clicks, impressions, CTR, position)
- `node scripts/tools/serpbear.mjs keywords superdots.sh --json` — keyword rank tracking
- `node scripts/tools/seonaut.mjs summary --json` — latest crawl audit summary
- `node scripts/tools/seonaut.mjs issues --json` — detailed SEO issues list
- `node scripts/tools/umami.mjs top-pages --days 7 --json` — top pages by Umami analytics
- **Google Search Console**: run `gsc.mjs queries` and `gsc.mjs opportunities` for actionable data
- **Bing Webmaster**: run `bing-webmaster.mjs stats` and `query-stats` — compare with GSC to spot Bing-specific opportunities
- **Keyword rankings**: use SerpBear to check tracked keyword positions and trends
- **New articles published this week**: are they indexed? initial ranking signals?
- **Top performers**: which articles gained the most impressions/clicks?
- **Declining articles**: which previously strong articles lost traffic?
- **Technical SEO**: use SEOnaut data and daily-seo-check for site health
- **Broken links, missing meta, structured data issues**
Post a structured report as a comment on this task with:
- Quick wins (easy improvements that could boost traffic)
2. @mention **@Content Manager** so they can review and unblock the Growth Analyst

tasks.title: [{{date}}] Growth opportunity analysis
description: Analyze the SEO Expert's audit and identify growth opportunities.
- `node scripts/tools/gsc.mjs opportunities --json` — quick wins: high impressions + low CTR
- `node scripts/tools/serpbear.mjs keywords superdots.sh --json` — keyword position data
- `node scripts/tools/umami.mjs referrers --days 7 --json` — referral sources for growth analysis
- **High-potential articles**: which articles are close to page 1 and could rank with small improvements?
- **Content gaps**: based on traffic patterns, what topics should we cover next?
- **Internal linking opportunities**: which new articles could link to/from existing content?
- **Refresh candidates**: which older articles could benefit from an update?
- **Conversion analysis**: are articles driving newsletter signups? which ones convert best?
Post a prioritized list of recommended actions as a comment:
2. @mention **@Content Manager** so they can create action tasks

tasks.title: [{{date}}] Create action tasks from weekly review
description: Review the SEO audit and growth analysis, then create concrete action tasks.
3. Prioritize: pick the top actions for this week
4. Create Paperclip tasks for each action, assigned to the right agent:
5. Comment on the parent task [{{_parent.identifier}}](/SUP/issues/{{_parent.identifier}}) with a summary of created tasks
